composition.serve_who: This is the Termodinamica SW 108-01 wiring schematic for the aircon system (fancoils/air handlers, touch screens, TMD bridges, sea water pumps for the two VRV18E1 compressor units). Two mirrored branches are shown: Port loop fed from "VRV18E1 ENGINE ROOM PORT" compressor unit and Stbd loop fed from "VRV18E1 ENGINE ROOM STBD" compressor unit, each with its own Main Switchboard 40A breaker B1, touch screen interface, thermostats, fancoil/air-handler units (MRMAXI18i/MRMAXI30i) per cabin, AC/DC current sensor, and TMD Bridge (Modbus RTU), tied together via a "Switch BUS Box Connection". All fancoil rows attach to 590-aircon-system (or specific fancoil nodes where the register has per-cabin nodes), the sea water pumps are TMD100 units cooling the VRV18E1 compressors (590-aircon-compressor-1/2), and the TMD bridges/touch-screen/current-sensor/bus infrastructure belongs to the aircon system's own control/monitoring infrastructure (no separate node — kept under 590-aircon-system as system-level facts, since no dedicated BUS/TMD infra node exists in the register).

infrastructure.system_name: Aircon Control/BUS Network (Termodinamica) — Touch Screens, TMD Internet Interface, Switch BUS Box, Ethernet/Router
facts: TMD Internet Interface (80W @ 24VDC) bridges the aircon control bus to the vessel Ethernet LAN via Internet Router — Port branch.
Touch Screen Interface Addr.1 (10W @ 24VDC) per branch (Port and Stbd) provides local HMI (Touch Screen 7 / SyxthSense) for the fancoil network.
Switch BUS Box Connection ties Port and Stbd branch bus networks together (shared infrastructure box, not equipment-specific).

BUS cable specification: min 0.5mm²/max 1.0mm², 100-120 ohm impedance, twisted pair ~10 twists/meter, shield/screen grounded only at compressor box side; DC 24VDC power supply cable run as single line from one source only.

Detail connection diagrams (right side of sheet) cover: SyxthSense Touch Screen wiring, VRV18E1 terminal block connection, SyxthSense+SubSlave Air Handler wiring, Air Handler wiring (master/slave/port/stbd), TS7E 7in touch screen & dual touch screen interfaces, AC/DC Current Sensor wiring, Switch BUS Box internal wiring — these are wiring detail views of the same equipment already captured, not separate systems.
Ground wire rule: compressor ground wire must connect to an independent anode/zinc only, never to any other device — warranty-voiding if violated.

uncertainties: Addr.5.0/Addr.5.1 pairing (Fwd Galley / Aft Galley) both attached to the single 590-aircon-fancoil-galley register node since no separate Aft Galley node exists — if the two are physically distinct fancoils in different galley zones, a dedicated 'Aft Galley' node may be needed.

Which VRV18E1 compressor unit (compressor-1 vs compressor-2 in register) corresponds to Port vs Stbd could not be independently confirmed beyond the sheet's own Port/Stbd labeling — assigned Port=compressor-1, Stbd=compressor-2 by convention only.

No dedicated infrastructure node exists in the register for the Termodinamica BUS/Switch-Box/TMD-bridge network; filed as facts under 590-aircon-system per rule 6/8 since no fitting standalone node was found.
